passage.text: The House by the Canal is a new Thai horror movie from a young director.
passage.reading: ðə ˈhaʊs baɪ ðə kəˈnæl ɪz ə ˈnuː ˈtaɪ ˈhɔːrər ˌmuːvi frəm ə ˈjʌŋ dəˈrɛktər.

passage.text: It's about a family who moves into an old wooden house.
passage.reading: ɪts əˈbaʊt ə ˈfæməli huː ˈmuːvz ˈɪntuː ən ˈoʊld ˈwʊdən ˈhaʊs.

passage.text: Soon, they hear noises in the house every night.
passage.reading: ˈsuːn, ðeɪ ˈhɪr ˈnɔɪzɪz ɪn ðə ˈhaʊs ˈɛvri ˈnaɪt.

passage.text: The movie has a lot of suspense.
passage.reading: ðə ˈmuːvi ˈhæz ə ˈlɑːt əv səˈspɛns.

passage.text: Sometimes it's so frightening that you'll want to close your eyes.
passage.reading: ˈsʌmtaɪmz ɪts ˈsoʊ ˈfraɪtənɪŋ ðæt juːl ˈwɑːnt tə ˈkloʊz jʊr ˈaɪz.

passage.text: The special effects are great, and the old house looks very real.
passage.reading: ðə ˈspɛʃəl ɪˈfɛkts ər ˈɡreɪt, ənd ði ˈoʊld ˈhaʊs ˈlʊks ˈvɛri ˈriːəl.

passage.text: The cast is young, but they're all very good.
passage.reading: ðə ˈkæst ɪz ˈjʌŋ, bʌt ðɛr ˈɔːl ˈvɛri ˈɡʊd.

passage.text: The actress who plays the mother is the star of the movie.
passage.reading: ði ˈæktrəs huː ˈpleɪz ðə ˈmʌðər ɪz ðə ˈstɑːr əv ðə ˈmuːvi.

passage.text: The ending is a little disappointing.
passage.reading: ði ˈɛndɪŋ ɪz ə ˈlɪtəl ˌdɪsəˈpɔɪntɪŋ.

passage.text: But it's still a very frightening movie, and the director is highly talented.
passage.reading: bʌt ɪts ˈstɪl ə ˈvɛri ˈfraɪtənɪŋ ˈmuːvi, ənd ðə dəˈrɛktər ɪz ˈhaɪli ˈtæləntɪd.

passage.text: We can't wait for her next movie.
passage.reading: wiː ˈkænt ˈweɪt fər hɜːr ˈnɛkst ˈmuːvi.

passage.text: Our score: four stars out of five.
passage.reading: aʊr ˈskɔːr: ˈfɔːr ˈstɑːrz ˈaʊt əv ˈfaɪv.
